s1.syndrome_frame: lesion on the eyelid with conjunctival and eyelid abnormalities in an anophthalmic socket
salient_findings: pearly lesion on the left lower eyelid
contraction of the conjunctival mucosal tissue
increased scleral show of the ocular prosthesis
key_facts: patient has a history of traumatic icicle injury to the left eye
patient underwent lower eyelid reconstruction 14 years prior
patient has an anophthalmic socket with an implant
patient's ocular prosthesis would spontaneously extrude from the socket
lesion on the left lower eyelid has been growing over the past few months
patient has conjunctival shrinkage and eyelid skin contracture
biopsy revealed nodular BCC with an infiltrative pattern
no signs of fibrosis or inflammatory infiltrate on biopsy
